meta.convention: spread = DA - RT; short PnL = +spread, long PnL = -spread; $/MWh; HE 1..24 period-ending America/Chicago
meta.system_reference: HB_BUSAVG (ERCOT bus-average hub) as congestion-free system price proxy; HB_HOUSTON = Raven zonal hub
meta.tradeable_rule: |t| >= 1.5 and EV>0 and Kelly f>0 and loss_p99 <= 20.0x EV
meta.data: real Yes Energy datalake prices via raw/price_panel (no mock)

sizing_rvn.basis: quarter-Kelly of a nominal 100 MW cap, capped by MW such that p99 hourly loss <= $5,000; 0 MW where not tradeable
